title: Warm Japanese Almond Casserole
description: A deliciously warm Japanese-inspired casserole made with toasted almonds and a variety of flavors.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together almonds and panko breadcrumbs.
In a separate bowl, mix together brown sugar, sesame oil, and vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and milk.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the almond mixture.
Pour the egg mixture over the almond mixture.
Top with the remaining almond mixture and marshmallows.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Sprinkle with cocoa powder before serving.
